subject: [AMBER] Query about generated (.pdb) files from GLYCAM Carbo builder

messages.author: Pinky Mazumder
messages.body:
Hi all,
I have built hemicellulose using the GLYCAM Carbohydrate builder. So, when
I downloaded the glycamstructure.tar.gz, I saw there were three (.pdb)
files *(1.pdb, 1_AMBER.pdb, and 1.AMBER_noh.pdb). *
Could you please let me know the difference between these three (.pdb)
files especially between *(1.pdb and 1_AMBER.pdb)* files?
Thanks in advance!
Regards.
Pinky
-- 
Pinky, Sharmi
AL,US

messages.author: Gustaf Olsson
messages.body:
Comparing the files, what difference can you see?
diff -y --suppress-common 1.pdb  1_AMBER.pdb
